name: gateway_discovery
description: Gateway coordination discovery vectors (GCP-4: backbone multicast and LoRa fallback). Independent CBOR/wire oracles per spec 08-gateway-coordination.md. Covers CoAP request/response format, GatewayInfo CBOR encoding, LoRaGatewayAnnounce wire format, IID comparison, and time master election.

vectors.name: coap_get_gateway_info
vectors.description: CoAP CON GET request for /.well-known/lichen-gw/info (GCP-4.1 backbone discovery).
vectors.note: Multicast to all-nodes IPv6 address on backbone link

vectors.name: coap_response_gateway_info
vectors.description: CoAP ACK 2.05 Content response with GatewayInfo CBOR payload.

vectors.name: coap_observe_registration
vectors.description: CoAP CON GET with Observe=0 to register for gateway info notifications.

vectors.name: gateway_info_minimal
vectors.description: Minimal GatewayInfo response with default capabilities and single gateway.

vectors.name: gateway_info_full
vectors.description: Full GatewayInfo with GPS sync, epoch, and 3-gateway interleaved slots.

vectors.name: gateway_info_contiguous
vectors.description: GatewayInfo with contiguous slot allocation mode (slots 20-39).

vectors.name: lora_announce_basic
vectors.description: LoRa gateway announce with GATEWAY flag set (GCP-4.2 fallback).

vectors.name: lora_announce_channel_zero
vectors.description: LoRa gateway announce on channel 0 (control channel).

vectors.name: lora_announce_max_channel
vectors.description: LoRa gateway announce on maximum channel 15.

vectors.name: gateway_flag_set
vectors.description: Type byte with GATEWAY flag set (0x80 bit).

vectors.name: gateway_flag_clear
vectors.description: Type byte without GATEWAY flag (regular announce).

vectors.name: iid_compare_lower_wins
vectors.description: IID comparison: lower IID wins slot conflict (per GCP-6.3).

vectors.name: iid_compare_higher_loses
vectors.description: IID comparison: higher IID loses slot conflict.

vectors.name: iid_compare_equal
vectors.description: IID comparison: equal IIDs.

vectors.name: time_master_gps_preferred
vectors.description: Time master election: GPS gateway wins over non-GPS with lower IID.

vectors.name: time_master_lowest_iid_among_gps
vectors.description: Time master election: lowest IID wins among GPS-equipped gateways.

vectors.name: time_master_lowest_iid_no_gps
vectors.description: Time master election: lowest IID wins when no GPS available.

vectors.name: time_master_empty
vectors.description: Time master election: no candidates returns null.

vectors.name: lora_announce_missing_gateway_flag
vectors.description: Error case: LoRa announce without GATEWAY flag should be rejected.

vectors.name: lora_announce_truncated
vectors.description: Error case: LoRa announce payload too short (need 10 bytes).

vectors.name: gateway_info_missing_iid
vectors.description: Error case: GatewayInfo CBOR without required IID field.

vectors.name: gateway_info_invalid_cbor
vectors.description: Error case: Truncated CBOR payload.
